includes: Premium leather interiors and air-conditioned Robinson R44 helicopters
blurb: Guests can enjoy helicopter tours over Santa Barbara, Ventura County, and the Malibu coastline, featuring views of beaches, mountains, cityscapes, and landmarks. Private and sunset tours are available, as well as custom charters for business travel, leisure, and special events. The fleet includes Robinson R44 helicopters with seating for up to three passengers.
extraNote: Flights may be delayed or cancelled due to poor weather conditions · Off-airport landings require land-owner permission and may incur additional fees · Request off-airport operations at least two days in advance · 777 Aviation Drive, Camarillo, California 93010
